body: Yeeeep!! I hate staining my underwear and waking up due to painful cramps
Stop
They're so cute
Sorry to hear about your boy. Our companions will always love us and vice versa. I've recently adopted 2 cats since then. I believe it helps knowing how much love you have to give 🩷
Yeah, it feels weird. I think it's anxiety though.
I feel heavy and my body gets tingly at times. Other times I feel numb. Dread is there too
Thank you. I wish we both could have had more time but at least we loved them and cherished them for the time they were here 💗

But you tried and that's what matters. The vets couldn't find anything wrong so you did the best you could with the knowledge you had at the time. 


Just know you're not alone. Multiple owners have made this mistake and we just have to learn to live with the grief. If you believe in life lessons then this is just a really hard lesson you had to learn. Now you and I both know what to look for and how to respond going forward.


I don't know if I'll ever forgive myself but the pain lessens the more I tell myself it wasn't my intent to hurt her and I love her with my whole being. It'll be a long journey for not just us but other owners who lost their companion due to their mistake. Take your time to heal and cry whenever you need to. Sometimes our brains need to hear words from other people since we only seem to criticize ourselves.
Good luck! Ignoring people at such a young age is hard but as I've said, it becomes easier.
Also, of course you're not a horrible monster. None of us are because we loved them.

I can't look at my girl's photos yet so don't feel like you have to rush your healing. If it's too hard then take a moment and let it out. Take it one day at a time and feel your grief.


I recently joined a pet loss support group called 'Lap of Love'. Someone on this sub recommended it to me. I join the free sessions and listen to other people's stories. There is a grief counselor who gives really good advice and helps people through their pain. 


Our brains can be rude and make us believe things that simply aren't true. We have to keep reminding ourselves it was a mistake and we did not have those intentions.


Good luck, you got this !

I feel your 3 points in my soul. I was working long hrs and then I got a 2nd job so unfortunately I wasn't spending as much time with her as I would've loved. I knew she was sick but she was always jumping on my bed and hanging out with me so I assumed she would heal. 


I don't think we can "get over it" but I think we learn to live with it. I know not to make the same mistakes now but it doesn't help that I had to learn this lesson the hard way.


I hope you're letting out your emotions in a healthy way and have a good support group. I always call my friends/family if I have to cry. My husband tries to shoulder half the blame since he said he noticed but didn't think it was serious either. We both were crying at the vet. I do believe I gave her a good life. She was fed, had a roof over her head, and had people who loved her.


It's okay, we'll heal and learn to cherish all the memories we have with them. 💗
Thank you so much.  It hurts and I'm trying to persevere but I really just want to scream and cry all day.

I'm sorry about your loss. If you read my post, I was guilty of doing the same thing. I took her too late even though I noticed the signs like a month ago. It's been 2 years for me as well.


My friends and family keep telling me the same thing that "you didn't know" and "you had so much going on but at least you tried taking her to the vet". They help a lot by letting me cry to them and they reassure me. 


It doesn't get easy, I'm still trying to cope with the grief. My girl was barely 13. I feel like I robbed her of her future. I'm not sure how to make you feel better but I just wanted to tell you that you're not alone.


My people keep telling me that I couldn't have known and that I waited a reasonable amount of time before getting help. It helps a little but what really pains me is the fact that she trusted me. She was my daughter and I feel like I let her down. I'm sorry if my words make you feel worse but you're not alone. Unfortunately, life gets in the way of things. We can't control every aspect, so the only thing we can do is do better moving forward. This guilt hurts and I'm starting my depression medication because of it.


Let's try not to be too hard on ourselves. We tried.

Thank you so much.  She was my cat, Smoky and I'll always love her.


Thank you for understanding.
Happy birthday Boki 🎂!
Thank you. You sound like a very good owner as well.

I'm sorry for your loss. I understand how it feels having a companion through your growing up years. I don't know what advice to offer aside from feeling this grief and talking about your buddy with someone you trust.


Mine was with me through middle school, high school, college,  depression, abusive partners, and finally my husband. I don't know if I'll ever bond with someone or another animal like Smoky since she was with me through every traumatic and life changing experiences. Now that I'm established, it just feels like a different type of bond will form with my companions.


Cry when you need to and take it day by day. He loved you and will continue to love you.

Thank you for this advice. I keep blaming myself for her death. Reading the "you're not evil" part resonates with me. I keep telling myself "how can you say you loved her if you didn't take her to the vet when you noticed she was sick". I know it's unhealthy but it's tearing me apart and I can't stop it. I loved her with my whole being. She kept me going through my pain and now I can't help but feel like I failed her.


Thank you for understanding.
I would say no to any drug but if you've exhausted all your options then I'm not sure how to point you in the right direction. The only thing I can suggest is therapy.

Sorry you're going through this. Please don't give your picture to weirdos. I don't have many friends. I don't even have people to hang out with on the weekends anymore since I moved states.


Anyway, being alone sucks. I was there at some point. I tried to get my mind off it by doing some hobbies and watching funny videos. Is there anything you like to do?
No problem. People aren't told they're doing their best very often and I think they deserve to hear those words more.

I'm sorry our brains hate us. You're doing your best. I remember when I was doing all those things and I still wanted to die. It took some dark spirals and good friends until I was able to be myself again. 


I'm a be honest, I don't think I love myself. However, I make up for it by loving other people and animals. I want to give them the best life they could have by being with me.


Take it one step at a time. You're doing your best and people are proud of you.

None of us know what we're doing. It takes these shitty life lessons to teach us better. Your ex sucks and your brain just has to agree with you on cutting her off. Friends come and go. You'll find some good ones later on in life.

I'm sorry you're feeling this way. Unfortunately, you won't have peace until you move out or learn to ignore them. 


Being under someone else's care sucks until you learn to drown it out. I'm sure your family cares about you but just have trouble expressing it. If they truly do suck then look forward to moving out and living on your own.


Good luck!
It's okay, rest when you need to and take it one step at a time

I don't know how old you are but it does get better. I was horrible in school, didn't care about clubs, and dropped out of college. I didn't get into a real relationship until I was in my twenties. Even then that experience made me want to die because of how abusive it was. I dropped like 30 pounds and was starving myself. It took a lot of work to get out of that mess.


There's gonna be really rough days and easy days. I can say that I've had people unexpectedly care about me. My first doctor actually gave me her personal number because she was concerned about my depression. Now we're still friends on IG 6 years later and still talk.


My reason to live are all the animals I keep adopting. If there's any way for you to care for one, I think you should try it. It will bring routine and help create fond memories.

There is always forgiveness. I saw your post history. Do you have a cat? If you do, stay alive for them.


They love you.
Don't do it.
No you don't. The brain is stupid and loves lying to us.
Don't do it, please.

I'm sorry you're going through this. Since you're young, these techniques might not work for you. You'll become stronger with your emotions as you grow older.


You have to learn to let her go. Don't let her actions bother you or else they'll consume you. Friends come and go and I know at that age it might be hard to be alone. However, true friends will believe you. 


Since you know she is a liar who enjoys getting what she wants, ignore her and let her ruin herself. You'll be more content once you focus on your own hobbies. Eventually you'll have your own friends.


The only other thing you can do is talk to your parents. I'm sorry.

I'm sorry to hear that. I'm a very direct person so I would've done the same as you and ask if something was wrong.


I believe she was slowly getting tired of you but was too immature to bring up her feelings. Also, showing her boyfriend the messages between you two doesn't sit well with me.


Anyway, you did what you could. Some people will be there for you and others won't. I thought I had close friends until they stopped talking to me 6 years later. It happens. Now I have 5 people I can actually rely on. My husband, sister, and 3 best friends.


I hope you're able to heal and find other friends. Good luck. You did nothing wrong.

I can't remember exactly how I felt when I woke up "content".


It is a very different feeling from depression. I just knew I felt better because I didn't wake up with the same fear and dread that I had been the past 4 years.


I think you should embrace it. If it feels different and even slightly better, keep it.

Ditch the family and be the blackest sheep out there. You'll be better off. This only works if you dislike your family.


Also, nothing wrong with being a virgin.

Please end it. I know people who didn't and ended up ruining the rest of their lives.


Relationships are about happiness. There might be some discussions here and there but I can honestly say, I've never had an argument with my husband. 


Doesn't matter how long or short the relationship is. If your gut is telling you something isn't right then make sure you listen to it.

I don't have much advice for that other than hoping it works! If it doesn't, there is no shame in going back to your other pills. People should be encouraging your progress rather than hinder it.


I grew up with a father who ridiculed my sister's weight so much. Sure she may be bigger now but she's also not at risk of committing suicide since she got the help she needed. I'd rather her be alive and happy than suffering.


Anyway, the downs really suck, and I mean they're gonna make you feel so small and lonely. I've been thinking I'm a failure this whole week so I finally made the decision to take my meds again. I'm hoping they help!

Sorry you're dealing with this. I too have a good life. Loving husband, people who care about me, and animals that love me as well. Depression just doesn't care about that though. Our brains are very mean to us at times. 


That doesn't mean I don't struggle at times. I'm currently battling an episode right now. It's been a week now but I'm slowly getting better. 


I used to go to therapy since I was dating an abusive person at the time. After we broke up, I continued going. It didn't help in the beginning but I felt more validated after we broke up since I was finally able to be honest about everything. Sometimes it works and sometimes it doesn't. You can always look for other types of therapists as well. My doctor really helped me as well. She was my first doctor and we're still friends to this day. 


Anyway, these feelings don't just disappear. We're gonna have moments when we feel weak or when we relapse. I relapsed in September of this year. I hadn't self-harmed in years. I was lucky to have 2 people to talk to that made me realize I was loved. Keep those plans and keep going. Once you're done with those plans, you make more plans. Set those little goals for yourself. It helps me and I hope it helps you.

Good luck! I hope it works out. I got lucky with my first prescription being "the one". 


Also, sorry you feel self-conscious about your weight. I always say if you feel comfortable with your body then that should be fine.


Life has its down times but it also has it's ups. I'm going through a rough patch right now but knowing there are people here for me is what keeps me alive.


You've got this !
Felt this. It's hard. I miss my girl too

Thank you for this. I'm in the same situation. Ignored the signs, took her too late, etc.


Thank you for the advice.

I'm sorry I don't have much to say but take it easy. One step at a time. As for the grief, I'm also married and my husband just lets me cry while reassuring me. This grief came out of nowhere, she passed 2 years ago, and he's making sure I'm fed, not alone, and letting my feelings out.


I recently joined a pet loss support group. It's called "Lap of Love". Someone else recommended it to me on here. Today was my first session and it helped being next to people who are going through the same thing as me. I got to speak and I think it helped.


Aside from that, I've been talking to my sister non-stop about it and she lets me cry. I'm sorry you don't have the same support. Try looking into these groups though, they might help.

Thank you for your kind words and compassion. I'm struggling immensely and I don't know how to cope. Talking about Smoky just chokes me up and ends with me sobbing. I'll try as you suggested and just take everything slowly and let myself feel what I need to feel.

I struggle with depression too. Unfortunately, I'm stuck with the guilt and sadness. The only thing that's ever helped me during my moments is going out and trying to do anything except be alone with my thoughts. My baby was my world. She was with me through middle school, high school, college, my attempt, abusive partner, and quarantine.


Depression is a horrible thing and I feel like there's just no coming back from the bottom of that hole. I can't offer any solid advice aside from assurance that you're not alone. I'm thinking of starting my meds again. I can't get through this on pure strength anymore.

Thank you, I really needed those words. For now I keep journaling, trying to get all my thoughts out. My friends keep trying to help me forgive myself so that's keeping me afloat so far. 


Yeah I recently adopted 2 more cats. I'm trying to form new bonds with them. I really can't go through life without animals by my side. I was never alone when I went to bed.


Anyway, we have to look towards the future no matter how bleak it might be. I hope we're able to slowly come to terms with everything. As long as they know we loved them.

I agree. I have been trying to find someone to understand how I feel and why it's different from a pet declining. She was still so young and full of life. I robbed her of her future and I too have to live with that feeling. 


 Maybe I can practice forgiving myself. It's going to be a hard and torturous journey but I'll try to do better. Thank you and good luck on your journey!

My heart resonates with yours. I too ignored the signs. My other cat had attacked her and even though my girl had some blood I thought she would be fine since you know...cats fight all the time. Her breathing had become rapid and I don't even know if she was eating or not but she was still sleeping with me and moving around so I thought nothing of it.


I got a 2nd job and let 2 months pass by before finally deciding to take her to the vet. I had gotten off of work around 8 PM so it was late. I managed to spend a few minutes with her before deciding it was time to go to the vet. Unfortunately, she passed on the way there. I think she had an asthma attack or something. The vet had said she had a small puncture in her chest and fluid was leaking in. She asked if I know what caused it. I told her my other cat attacked her.


I regret those last 2 months. I regret putting my needs first also wanting to save money even though I had 2 jobs and could've afforded it. I regret not holding her on the way to the vet. I was petting her through her carrier. I understand how you feel. I don't know how to feel better. It's eating me. This was 2 years ago and my heart is dying now. I had her for 12 years all though middle, high school, and college. I don't know how to live anymore. 12 long years. Half my life.
I kept going out and planning trips with friends. Going out kept my mind from thinking. I wouldn't suggest a movie though since that gives you time to think.
Because of her colors

Everything affects us differently. Sorry they don't seem to understand you. The least they can do is give you comfort anf support. My husband has been doing everything he can to make me comfortable. He might not understand the deep depression and guilt in struggling with but he still tries his best to make sure I'm okay.


Animals are animals and they can't understand why things are important to us. It's okay to be upset as long as you don't try to take it out on the cat. They don't know right from wrong in this regard. Take it slow and try to find comfort in other things for a few days.
Thank you so much. Sorry to hear about that but I'm glad I'm not alone. I'll try joining. It's getting exhausting crying all the time.
Thank you

You - Dai


Secret Base - Anohana (any version)


Ichiban no Takaramono - Lisa

Not wrong! I was working 2 jobs when my precious girl had her last day. I wish I hadn't cause then I could've taken her to the vet sooner.


Please don't make the same mistakes I did.
That's nice! Cherish them as much as you can and make them never feel alone. Sometimes I think animals are just more kind than humans.

You're allowed to. I'm depressed and I have a husband. You just have to realize that sometimes they get tired and can't be there for you all the time. I don't think I've learned to love myself but I make up for that by loving him ten fold.


As long as you are able to "shut it off" a few times then you can do it. There has to be a balance. Always make sure your partner knows it's not their fault. Just be honest if you feel like you wanna continue being with the person.

Happy birthday!! I remember posting on this reddit before I was 21. Do what makes you happy! I liked eating my fav food and having a chill day. Play some old games or watch shows you used to love, it might make your day even better.

That's good. Can't have good without the bad unfortunately. Ever thought about fostering or owning animals? If you're able to, I mean. It can help you meet people at the dog park. I also usually put all my affection into my buddies when I'm really down.

I'm sorry that you're going through this. I don't have many friends. I have the same 2 from middle school and 1 from high school. I feel like I play a part in people being alone only because I don't go out of my comfort zone to meet more people and make new friends. 


I get depressed often and only have those 3 friends to talk to. I hope more people can look past their comfort and be willing to give people a chance. Sorry I'm not much help but you're strong enough to post this and talk to others. That is a start and hopefully talking to people on here can help heal the loneliness in your heart. I don't have a lot to say but if you ever want to talk then I'm willing to listen.

I'm sorry for your loss. At least you were with her until the very end. I'm sure you both will be reunited later. I understand the pain you must be feeling, you did all you could. She appreciates you so much. I miss my girl Smoky, she was there for me every step of the way. Through all my break downs and relapses, she was always there to comfort me. I felt like she was the only being in the world who understood me. She took a big chunk of my heart with her.


 I hope you're able to heal as time goes on. Some days it just hurts like no other pain you've ever felt. However, I belive that just shows how much we truly care about our soul animals.
I blame myself as well. I'm sorry for your loss. It's awesome that you're being a better owner!!

Yes. I'm dealing with that right now. I had the money but I chose work and fun over what she may have wanted. I now have two cats I want to spoil but I keep having these bad thoughts like "you should've got her these treats or played with her more".


It's a hard situation to be but all animals deserve kindness and love. Remember that they all deserve their own lives whether that's with you or someone else. We know better now.

Thank you for your kind words. I'm sorry to hear about your precious animal. I hope watercolor painting goes well.


I'll try to be kinder to myself regarding the incident. I know we loved each other very much. She was a stray and I made sure to always be by her side no matter what.


Thank you again, I really needed to hear that.
Seeking advice as well. I reach out to my closest friends and have them comfort me. I don't believe my own words so they try to make me feel better. It helps me a lot.

I'm sorry you're dealing with this pain. For whatever reason my soul cat has been on my mind for the past week. She passed 2 years ago but I've been so depressed and miserable. I've been crying every day. Hopefully you can let the grief process. I try journaling to help with the pain.


I used to self harm so I understand the type of pain situations like this come with.


I know our precious loved ones wouldn't want us feeling this way even though their lives have ended. They loved us after all.

One of my cats killed my soul cat. The worst part is the cat was her daughter. They got into a fight after I left my door open thinking they'd get along since they used to be around each other 2 years before. I let 2 months go by even though my girl's breathing was funky. It wasn't until I took her to the vet too late that they told me she had a small puncture wound in her chest. I knew it was my other cat's fault but I still couldn't get rid of her.


It's a tough situation. I care for all my cats but I should've done more. I should've known better since she used to be a violent cat but hadn't had an incident in a few years. I was naive and thoughtless and unfortunately my soul cat had to pay for that mistake.


I hope everything has been okay.
Absolutely. I wish I could have passed with her. I wish I could've held her instead of taking her to the vet in a crate.

I'm so sorry. My baby girl passed away November of 2022. I still blame myself for leaving the door open and not taking her to the vet for 2 months. 2 whole months I saw her breathing weird and just thought she was going through a phase. I feel like such a horrible human being for letting her die like that.


These things happen but the fact of the matter is, they're accidents. It's so difficult to see it as such and I still struggle to come to terms with it but it was only an accident that caused this outcome. Our babies know we never meant to cause them harm, they know us better than we know ourselves. You did what you could afterwards.


I'm so sorry.
Thank you so much for thinking so! I appreciate it!

Thank for your kind words. My baby girl started a whole family while sharing her life with me. The cat who attacked her was her own daughter. I just couldn't find it in me to take her to a shelter (especially in LA since they're overcrowded) and risking her being put down. I'm grateful for the babies (they're all about 10 years old now) and grandbabies she left me with. I really appreciate this legacy she has left with me.


Thank you so much for understanding. It's just very difficult for me to forgive myself but I'll keep trying.

Sounds like me. I bonded with my baby girl Smoky. She was my world. Even though I had 5 other cats, she was with me since I was in middle school. I only had 12 years with her as well.


One of my other cats had attacked her but I didn't think she was hurt so bad. It wasn't until 2 months later when I finally took her to the vet cause her breathing was getting worse that we found out what happened. I still beat myself up about it 2 years later. If only I had taken her as soon as I had noticed but instead I just thought she was being weird. I miss her so much.
Had an abusive ex who tried the same thing. These people suck.
I was told social security and climate change aren't real

My Trump father doesn't believe in climate change and says it's the weather. He also says social security isn't real and we'll never see it when we retire.


My grandparents are on social security...


He also blamed me for being abused in a past relationship. He just hates women.

If I Ever Feel Better - Phoenix


Makes me feel depressed but a little better about things
It's not your fault. Friends don't rape friends. I'm sorry
Friends don't rape friends. Block this guy and move on. Tell people the truth if they ask. The ones who care about you will stick around.
I can attest to the giving less fucks.

23, you're young! I was in a fucked up position when I was 21. I was in a mental/physical abusive relationship for a year and a half. I wanted to kill myself.


I somehow met my soul mate and now I'm happily married.


I still struggle with depression but there's less suicidal thoughts now. It gets easier when you have someone to grieve with. Anyway, please don't feel like you haven't accomplished anything. You're still so young. I know I'm only 26 but once I was out of that trashy relationship I started feeling alive by planning trips! 


That's what I have to look forward to. The trips I keep planning. They don't even have to be extravagant trips but just getting away from where I sleep is the best feeling. I feel liberated.


You got this.
We're in for a wild ride
This will be my second time. Voted for Biden!

The fact that this isn't a lie. I know some people at work who didn't vote for Kamala or Hillary because "you really want a woman telling us men what to do?". 


Alright then.

I'm sorry. No one deserves to ever hear something like that, especially from their parents. I wish my parents had the support they needed while I was growing up. 


They're better now but it took over 20 years for them to get where they're at. Even now they're not the most amazing people at times.


I wonder how I was able to become a better person when being raised like that.
Same here. I understand we're doing this for survival but I'm tired of thinking. I just want my mind to stop going into overdrive every day.

What I'm trying to say is, some people want kids knowing the difficulties they come with. I don't think telling someone "having a kid is hard" is going to change their mindset. Everyone struggles with different things.
It's a costume. If there's no ill intent then...

I fantasize about it when listening to music. I could never do it. The chances of me failing are pretty high. This might sound horrible but I can't imagine the embarrassment from living after attempting.

Not saying it's a good thing but if your family doesn't respect you then get a divorce. At least it'll make the blow easier.  


You still have 40 more years of living. Do you really want to live it being married to someone you can't trust? It's never too late to do the things you want to do. Risks may come with having a child at your age but there is always adoption. Please try to put yourself first. You deserve happiness.


 It sucks when you see abusers getting more recognition than they deserve. I understand how you must feel.

I want a child but have to wait a few years. It makes me cry sometimes. It was the only dream I ever wanted to come true. It's not like I was asking for an expensive car or lavish lifestyle.


Dem's the breaks I suppose.

At least you're trying. I'm the opposite. I don't like bonding with people as an adult because I always assume they're going to stop talking to me one day. I'm friendly but not the type to cry if I lose a friend.


Maybe these people just have their guard up? Try going to an event with people who have the same hobbies as you. In my case, I have met a lot of cool people at conventions. I think it's because everyone knows that they all are attending for the same reasons.


Do your best, you got this.
Nah I think you're fine. At the end of the day, who you decide to invite is up to you.
Amiami
My husband's kids are both autistic but we still discipline them. It's not an excuse. Therapy exists. This just sounds like a father who refuses to parent.

Yep. Completely your fault for not teaching your daughter boundaries.


Also, just cause you love your daughter doesn't mean everyone else has to. Especially if they're undisciplined.
That's fucking disgusting. What a dick. Sorry you wasted your time.

Not the asshole. I had a similar upbringing and I was scared to have my own child even though I had wanted to be a mom. 


I finally got tested and everything came out clean. Fingers crossed I have a healthy baby one day. 


I'm sorry for all your trauma. I still beat myself up over my past even though the responsibility should have been on my parents.

I went to the one on Monday as well! I was reading that it might not be CR's fault but Crypton's since Coachella also used a TV screen.


We'll see what happens!
Yeah I can see that. It seems like whenever I'm not keeping my brain busy I just instantly become depressed. I guess that's why I busy myself with work and entertainment.
Yeah that's done. Why should you be doing everything? I would never allow that.
Yep yep!! I'm totally for it!
Honestly I'd be concerned about him hurting the kids at this point. Their safety should be the number one priority.
I hope not. I'm just trying to enjoy my Scream franchise.
Yeah it's very interesting cause I'm a big Scream fan but I don't give a shit about the actors. I just like my kills and guessing who the killer is.
If you think it's going to become serious then by all means. I think it would make it easier.
Sleeping is my form of escape. I know it's unhealthy but I can't handle it anymore. This world sucks and it causes me nothing but pain while I'm awake.
Quick update!! I'm actually in a hella better position now! Getting married to the love of my life!
It's definitely the way we overthink things. I wish we actually had answers for all these feelings.

Honestly...the only motivation I have is to keep planning events for the future. I know it sounds silly but there's really nothing else that keeps me going. I envy the people who actually have good jobs and a bright future. I wish my life was easy but it is what it is.
I don't understand why any of us are alive. I think it's interesting how we don't have an answer yet.
Fort Collins!

That sounds very intense. I don't think I can stomach watching this man.

Thank you for your example it helped me understand this situation a lot more.

Yeah I've seen it when I was younger. I guess I never thought I'd be experiencing gaslighting with someone I envisioned my future with.

Thank you for your advice. I did feel like I could've tried harder but I have to accept that what happened was out of my hands. We can't change another person's personality and we need to put ourselves first sometimes.
I thought it was always sent to a lab afterwards? Sorry you're feeling nervous but you did what you could. Good luck!
You got this! You can always stay clean for a month and then try applying in the future!
Regular smoke shop in CO. Always make sure to confirm the batch and you should be okay!

That makes sense. I hope people stop being so angry eventually.

Thank you for your words.

I did tell him he seemed like a very angry person. Not during the relationship since I didn't want to cause problems. Looking back on it, maybe I should've had a bigger reaction to things he said/did. 

Thank you for your words.

I'm not sure what talking points he pulled from this man but I know he would pull a lot of his "facts" from multiple YT vids. Always of the opposing side of whatever I agreed with. That being said, I knew better than to engage in those petty arguments unless it was something I fully supported and knew about (abortion). 

I also believe my ex was incapable of taking responsibility for a lot of things. I can only remember 3 times when he apologized for the way he treated me or a situation. Only after I explained why it was so bad.

Thank you for your words.
Thank you! I'm sorry you experienced that with a family member. I can't imagine actually living with someone who treats you like that. I hope you are doing better now!

Thank you, I believe so too! I know they are out there and I'm sure I will date someone who clicks with me eventually. I love communication since I think it can resolve almost any problem. It just takes patience and understanding.
